style(frontend): adjust component text sizes and refine cart styling (mono-repo)
This commit makes minor visual adjustments to several frontend components.
- Navigation item text size in `nav-item.tsx` reduced from `text-sm` to `text-xs`. Active link styling simplified by removing specific `text-neutral-400` color. - Search and cart label text sizes in `actions.tsx` reduced from `text-sm` to `text-xs`. - Cart item count display in `actions.tsx` restructured for improved layout and visual consistency, including updated styling classes.

refactor(frontend): Relocate application to frontend subdirectory
This change moves all existing frontend files into a dedicated directory to prepare the repository for a monorepo structure. Configuration files like package.json and .idea have been updated to reflect the new file paths.
feat(backend): initialize and configure Strapi with Supabase

feat(backend): initialize and configure Strapi with Supabase (mono-repo)
This commit sets up the Strapi backend application within the `backend/` directory. It includes the initial configuration for connecting to Supabase and generates necessary TypeScript types for content models and components. New npm run configurations have been added for Strapi development and build.

feat(backend): initialize and configure Strapi with Supabase (mono-repo)

New npm run configurations have been added for Strapi development and build.

feat(frontend): configure Next.js image loading and organize assets (mono-repo)
This commit configures Next.js to load images from the Strapi backend by adding a remotePatterns entry in next.config.ts, enabling dynamic image fetching.
It also updates the .gitignore file to specifically exclude only .env, and relocates common public assets (hero-1.jpg, left-arrow.png, logo.svg) into the frontend/public directory for better project structure.

``` feat(frontend): set up essential layout, navigation, and pages (mono-repo)
This commit introduces the foundational UI structure for the frontend. It integrates the 'Inter_Tight' font as the primary sans-serif font. Core components like 'Header', 'Nav', 'Actions', and 'Logo' are added, forming the basis of the application's global layout.
New layouts and placeholder pages are created for 'Women', 'Men', and 'Objects' sections, establishing initial routing. Global site configuration and TypeScript types are also defined.
Additionally, the '@radix-ui/react-slot' package is introduced. ```

feat(build): set up pnpm monorepo workspace (mono-repo)
This commit initializes the project as a pnpm monorepo, defining the workspace structure and adding essential ignore rules.
The `pnpm-workspace.yaml` file is introduced, declaring `backend`, `frontend`, and `packages/*` as workspace packages. It also configures specific dependencies to be built only, optimizing the build process.
Additionally, a comprehensive `.gitignore` file is added to prevent unnecessary files from being tracked. This includes `node_modules`, build outputs, editor-specific files, and various debug logs.

feat(types): create shared Strapi types package (mono-repo)
This commit introduces the new `@arton/types` package, designed to centralize and re-export generated Strapi type definitions for use across the monorepo.
The `package.json` file sets up the package metadata, including its name, version, and entry points.
The `src/index.ts` file contains the re-export statements, making content types and components easily accessible throughout the `arton` project.

build(repo): set up pnpm monorepo workspace (mono-repo)
This commit migrates the project to a pnpm monorepo structure. Individual pnpm-workspace.yaml files from backend and frontend are removed, as workspace management is now handled at the root.
Package names in backend/package.json and frontend/package.json are updated to @arton/backend and @arton/frontend respectively, adopting a scoped naming convention. A new internal workspace dependency, @arton/types, is introduced for shared type definitions. Additionally, @strapi/plugin-graphql is added to the backend.

feat(frontend): implement Strapi GraphQL category fetching (mono-repo)
This commit introduces core functionalities for fetching and displaying category data from the Strapi backend using GraphQL.
A new `fetchApi` utility is added to handle GraphQL requests to Strapi, including error management and Next.js caching strategies (revalidate, tags). Building upon this, the `getCategories` utility is created to specifically retrieve category information.
The `men/page.tsx` and `women/page.tsx` are updated to utilize this `getCategories` function, allowing them to dynamically display lists of categories. Additionally, generic TypeScript types for Strapi API responses (`StrapiResponse`, `StrapiCollectionResponse`, etc.) are defined to ensure robust type safety throughout the frontend. The shared `@arton/types` package is used for category type definitions.

style(frontend): adjust component text sizes and refine cart styling (mono-repo)
This commit makes minor visual adjustments to several frontend components.
- Navigation item text size in `nav-item.tsx` reduced from `text-sm` to `text-xs`. Active link styling simplified by removing specific `text-neutral-400` color. - Search and cart label text sizes in `actions.tsx` reduced from `text-sm` to `text-xs`. - Cart item count display in `actions.tsx` restructured for improved layout and visual consistency, including updated styling classes.

feat(types): create shared Strapi types package (mono-repo)
This commit introduces the new `@arton/types` package, designed to centralize and re-export generated Strapi type definitions for use across the monorepo. This package aims to ensure type consistency and reusability across all `arton` projects.
To enable this, the repository has been restructured into a pnpm monorepo. This includes: - Introducing a root `pnpm-workspace.yaml` to define the workspace structure and removing obsolete individual configs. - Renaming the `backend` and `frontend` packages to `@arton/backend` and `@arton/frontend` respectively, adhering to monorepo naming conventions. - Adding a comprehensive root `.gitignore` file to manage version control for the entire workspace.
Finally, the `@strapi/plugin-graphql` has been added to the backend to provide GraphQL API capabilities, further enhancing data access for the frontend.
